what_to_detect: An evoke trigger resolves and its controller sacrifices the permanent whose evoke cost was paid.
near_miss: The permanent was cast for its mana cost, so the evoke trigger's condition is false and it stays on the battlefield.
record_fields: zone_change events of the resolution's effect half
acting line keyword_display_name (a keyword line's script_api_type is Keyword, so api cannot select it)

what_to_detect: A card with evoke is affordable through its evoke cost when its mana cost cannot be paid.
near_miss: The card is not affordable when neither its mana cost nor its evoke cost can be paid.
record_fields: candidate acting line keyword_display_name (the evoke alternative cost)
